The Silk & Cotton Trade Employees' Mutual Aid
Society, 97 Jinkee Road, is arranging to hold a social
meeting of members on its premises between 8.30 p.m.
and 11 p.m. On January 1. It is expected that about
150 members will attend.
The programme will consist of
1. Singing : "Song of the Mutual Aid Society" (社歌)
"Welcome New Year" (歡迎新年)
"Song of Welcoming New Year (歡迎新年歌).
2. Dramas entitled "Roaring Sound" (吼声) and
"New Father" (新的父親).
3. Harmonica music.
4. Story-telling and comedy.
Another social meeting of members will held
in the society premises between 8.30 p.m. and 11 p.m.
on January 2, during which old style Peiping plays will
be staged.
Both programmes have been scrutinized and found
to contain nothing of an objectionable nature.
Kao Yen Ken

As the aim of this project is to raise funds for charitable purposes, the management of the Carlton Theatre was instructed to apply to the Council for the necessary permission. A sacred concert is to be given by the
Shanghai Songsters at the Moore Memorial Church,
316 Yu Ya Ching Road, between 8 p.m. and 11 p.m.,

advisor to the Shanghai Songsters, stated that the
concert will be of religious nature and that nothing
of political significance will be introduced.
